main_sampler.description: Self-speculative decoding, B=32: one forward drafts the whole [M] block in one shot (bidirectional within block) plus the causal boundary token; one causal verification forward accepts the longest draft prefix matching the AR top-1 predictions and appends the next AR token; KV cache kept for accepted tokens

credited_component.text: adapting a pretrained causal AR OCR model into a parameter-shared block-diffusion drafter and causal AR verifier

design.other_detail: D15 other: 0.5 causal next-token cross-entropy on the clean stream plus 0.5 masked block-diffusion cross-entropy with w(t)=1 over two complementary masked streams; GRPO on the AR path afterwards.
design.inherited_from: GLM-OCR checkpoint (LM head, decoder); block diffusion and complementary masking from Block Diffusion (Arriola et al., 2025) and Fast-dLLM v2 (Wu et al., 2025a)

census.F2_detail: Self-speculative decoding with top-1 verification: committed tokens are the AR verifier argmax (greedy); one-shot diffusion draft over B=32 mask tokens; longest matching draft prefix accepted. Equality test states greedy, repetition penalty 1.0. Direct block-diffusion mode (other rows) reveals tokens above confidence threshold tau_c.
